verdict.rationale: Data region or residency selection is a fair question for an AI coding agent, but the evidence pack never documents choosing where data is stored. Provider choice, local models, an internal AI gateway and self-run `opencode serve` backends control where requests go, not storage residency, so they are adjacent at best and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
